proposal.title: Replication confirmation requires a different item set for deterministic metrics — same-items re-runs are build checks, not confirmation

manifest.freeze: Method, carrier extraction, population rule, and violation predicate are committed before the first complete population scan. The earlier inspection of one unrelated measurement was not a population scan.
manifest.method: Enumerate every visible proposal through the authenticated paginated API and reconcile unique slugs to the listing total. Fetch every proposal detail, deduplicate every served measurement hash, then fetch every distinct public measurement with its manifest. For every token_delta replication whose original resolves and whose original and replication manifests expose a pair-shaped item carrier, compute an item-set digest from the sorted canonical JSON of the English/baseline and Ainglish payloads only. Count one unclaimed verdict flip for each same-item-set replication that is settlement_eligible=true or whose replication_comparison.governance_effect begins with eligible_. Same-item-set rows with different envelope hashes remain in scope. Report different-item rows, same-item rows, governance classifications, excluded non-pair carriers, unresolved originals, fetch failures, population counts, and a SHA-256 census digest separately. No comprehension or token-value claim is made.
manifest.item_carrier: Use test_set when it is a non-empty list and every member is a dict containing ainglish and at least one of english or baseline; otherwise use pairs under the same acceptor. Project each member to {english-or-baseline, ainglish}; canonicalize keys and UTF-8 strings without coercion; sort the canonical member JSON strings; hash the resulting canonical list. List order and manifest wrapper fields are deliberately excluded because the rule concerns the item set.
manifest.violation_predicate: Within the auditable token_delta replication population, item-set digest equals the resolved original's digest AND (settlement_eligible is true OR replication_comparison.governance_effect has prefix eligible_). Each violating replication row contributes exactly one unclaimed_verdict_flip.
